attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his Substack post; he presents it as his own tweet.

semantics.note: 'Will collapse' is firm and has no date. The context points to GenAI, though the industry could arguably be wider AI. The 'because' clause applies to both the building and the collapse; the normalisation keeps the cause.

contract.note: The plain reading of collapse (broad, sustained breakdown) is ordinary and fair. The contract rightly says finite survival cannot contradict an undated forecast.

evidence.note: Crunchbase shows foundational-AI funding rising through Q1 2026. That shows no collapse had happened by then, but it cannot settle an undated forecast.
Reuters (Oct 2026) reports a fall in AI-infrastructure shares tied to interest rates. This is an adjacent sector and a short-term move, not an industry collapse, and the cause is not outliers.

reviews.rationale: This is a firm forecast with no deadline. The packet shows no broad, sustained GenAI collapse by the cutoff, and nothing ties one to outlier limits. Funding growth and a share slump do not settle it either way. Not happening yet is not failure, so the claim stays unresolved.

attribution.note: Marcus's own words. 'Then' refers to the 1990s papers he wrote with Pinker.

semantics.note: A claim that a difficulty persisted from the 1990s to 2024. Reading 'still' as up to the post date is reasonable.

contract.note: Counting extrapolation and robustness to altered inputs as 'outliers' fits the post's own examples. The contract needs only persistence, not equal severity, and excludes Marcus's own papers.

evidence.note: A 1992 IJCNN paper by independent NASA authors found that backpropagation networks failed to extrapolate. This covers the 1990s endpoint.
GSM-Plus, revised July 2024 before the post, finds 25 LLMs lack robustness on altered math problems. This covers the current endpoint, though some perturbations were handled well.

reviews.rationale: Independent research documents extrapolation failures in early-1990s neural networks and robustness failures on altered inputs in 2024 LLMs before the post. That meets the persistence condition. Partial resilience in GSM-Plus narrows how broad the problem is but does not show it was eliminated.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in the opening of his post.

semantics.note: Framed as an observation, but the group is defined by what people understand and 'wasted' is an evaluative word, so it cannot be tested.

contract.note: The contract rightly finds no reproducible test: no named group, no period, no measure of spending, and no standard for 'waste'.

reviews.rationale: The claim does not identify who wasted money, how much, or what counts as waste. Whether investors understood the outlier problem cannot be observed, so investment losses could not confirm it. The case is complete but the claim cannot be tested, so it is not adjudicable.

attribution.note: Marcus's own sentence in his post.

semantics.note: The timing is hedged ('seems imminent'). The firm part is conditional: when deflation comes, it will be caused by unmet expectations. The normalisation turns 'when it comes' into an unconditional 'it will happen' and drops the antecedent.

contract.note: The contract applies a plain reading to hedged timing language, which policy forbids. It also treats the event and its cause as one forecast instead of a conditional whose antecedent is the deflation arriving.

evidence.note: An August 2024 commentary says the hype bubble is deflating. That is opinion, not a measured financial contraction.
A secondary summary of Reuters on Chinese AI and chip shares in 2026. Different geography, focused on hardware, with mixed causes, and two years after the post.
Anthropic's own disclosure of continued expansion in May 2026. It covers one company, not the sector.

reviews.rationale: The only timing claim is hedged ('seems imminent'), so it is not scored. The firm part is the cause, which depends on a deflation arriving. The packet does not establish a broad, sustained GenAI deflation, so that antecedent is unknown and the conditional is not scored either.
